institution: IIIT Allahabad (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: Strong placement record; average package reported higher than some IITs; 100% B.Tech placement in 2022; companies like Google, Amazon, Sumo Logic, Goldman Sachs visit campus.
Air-conditioned classrooms, well-equipped labs, hostels, mess, library, and campus-wide wifi frequently praised.
Faculty described as well-qualified; curriculum considered strong and updated for most UG branches like ECE, IT.
Students highlight a strong coding environment and culture throughout the year.

key_negative_themes.notes: Lowest-rated category (3.3/5); some students feel fees are high relative to facilities offered.
PhD scholars report inadequate research support, citing outdated curriculum expectations and lack of basic tools/subscriptions.
Limited to a few sports (cricket, football, volleyball); some hostels lack extensive facilities.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Top IIIT, it developed my character a lot - strong infra, good academics, high average package
The rise and fall of IIIT Allahabad - PhD curriculum not fully updated, no research subscription support
Infrastructure just average, hostels lack facilities, but academics among best in country
90% ECE placement in 2022, average salary ~15 LPA, top package 82 LPA

conclusion: Overall sentiment toward IIIT Allahabad is strongly positive, driven primarily by its placement outcomes, infrastructure, and academic reputation as a top-tier IIIT. The main recurring criticism relates to perceived value for money and gaps in PhD/research-level support.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
